text_sections.label: Special Digivolution Condition
text_sections.text: [App Fusion] [Mediamon] & [Dreammon]: Cost 0 If 2 such cards are linked together, stack the link card on top and digivolve

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: ＜Alliance＞ [On Play] [When Digivolving] You may link 1 level 4 or lower Digimon card from your hand or this Digimon's digivolution cards to this Digimon without paying the cost. [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon gets linked, you may play 1 play cost 4 or lower card with the [Appmon] trait from your hand without paying the cost.

text_sections.label: Link Condition
text_sections.text: ＜Link＞ [Appmon] trait: Cost 3 (Plug this card from the hand or battle area sideways into the specified Digimon in the battle area.)

text_sections.label: Link Effect
text_sections.text: [When Linking] To 1 of your opponent's Digimon, give -4000 DP for the turn for each of your Digimon with the [Appmon] trait.
